#!/bin/sh
OCC="php /var/www/html/occ"
$OCC app:enable files_external || true

mid() {
  php -r '$n=$argv[1];$j=json_decode(stream_get_contents(STDIN),true);if(is_array($j))foreach($j as $m){if(isset($m["mount_point"])&&strpos($m["mount_point"],$n)!==false){echo $m["mount_id"];break;}}' "$1" 2>/dev/null
}

ensure() {
  NAME="$1"; DIR="$2"
  if ! $OCC files_external:list --all --output=json 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$DIR"; then
    $OCC files_external:create "$NAME" local null::null -c datadir="$DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  ID=$($OCC files_external:list --all --output=json 2>/dev/null | mid "$NAME")
  if [ -n "$ID" ]; then
    $OCC files_external:option "$ID" readonly true >/dev/null 2>&1
    $OCC files_external:option "$ID" enable_sharing true >/dev/null 2>&1
    echo "ensured external mount '$NAME' (id=$ID) -> $DIR"
  else
    echo "WARN: '$NAME' present/created but could not read id to set options"
  fi
}

ensure "Tailey (private)" /family-data/tailey
ensure "Family recovery"  /family-data/family
exit 0

set -e
find /tmp/app.log -mmin -5 | grep -q .
A=$(grep -ac 'RTA Websocket .* event:' /tmp/app.log || true)
if [ "$A" -gt 0 ]; then
  [ "$A" = "$(cat /tmp/hb-rta 2>/dev/null)" ] || echo "$A" > /tmp/hb-rta
  find /tmp/hb-rta -mmin -10 | grep -q .
fi
WS='WebSocket session reconnected'
WS="$WS\|NetherNet Broadcaster started on ID"
B=$(grep -ac "$WS" /tmp/app.log || true)
[ "$B" = "$(cat /tmp/hb-ws 2>/dev/null)" ] || echo "$B" > /tmp/hb-ws
find /tmp/hb-ws -mmin -240 | grep -q .
N=$(grep -ac 'Generated nonce for XUID' /tmp/app.log || true)
T=$(grep -ac 'Transferred bedrock client' /tmp/app.log || true)
if [ "$N" -le "$T" ] || [ "$T" != "$(cat /tmp/hb-join 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  echo "$T" > /tmp/hb-join
fi
find /tmp/hb-join -mmin -2 | grep -q . && exit 0
if [ ! -f /tmp/diag-done ]; then
  : > /tmp/diag-done
  D=/opt/app/config/diag
  mkdir -p "$D" || true
  S="$D/wedge-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
  PID=$(jps 2>/dev/null | grep -v Jps | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1) || true
  [ -n "$PID" ] && jstack "$PID" > "$S.jstack" 2>&1 || true
  awk 'NR>1 && $4=="01" {print $2, $3}' /proc/net/tcp6 > "$S.sockets" 2>&1 || true
  grep -a 'Signaling websocket open\|Generated nonce\|Transferred bedrock' \
    /tmp/app.log | tail -40 > "$S.tail" 2>&1 || true
fi
exit 1

set -u
JAR=/opt/app/MCXboxBroadcastStandalone.jar
OUT=/patched/MCXboxBroadcastStandalone.jar
cp "$JAR" "$OUT"
# Fail soft. A Renovate bump can leave the vendored source behind,
# and a patch that no longer compiles must fall back to stock
# rather than crashloop the server.
if javac -nowarn -cp "$JAR" -d /patched/classes /patch-src/*.java \
  && (cd /patched/classes && jar uf "$OUT" com); then
  echo "patch applied"
else
  echo "PATCH FAILED - falling back to stock jar"
  cp "$JAR" "$OUT"
fi
rm -rf /patched/classes

set -eu
mkdir -p /frenzone-pack/scripts /frenzone-pack/loot_tables/frenzone
cp -L /frenzone-source/manifest.json /frenzone-pack/manifest.json
cp -L /frenzone-source/main.js /frenzone-pack/scripts/main.js
cp -L /frenzone-source/treasure.json \
  /frenzone-pack/loot_tables/frenzone/player_fishing_treasure.json
echo "Staged FrenZone fishing pack as regular files."
